VBO:0200360.summary: Calm in its general temperament, the Chortai becomes sharply focused when game comes into view. This southern Russian sighthound combines speed with stamina, and uses scent as well as sight to find quarry. Its working rhythm shifts from a leisurely walk or trot to a full gallop during pursuit.
VBO:0200360.shortDescription: A calm, keen-eyed Russian sighthound that pairs speed with stamina and uses its nose as well as its eyes when hunting.

sources.title: Russian Kynological Federation — Hortaya Borzaya standard (2022)
sources.evidence: RKF current Hortaya Borzaya standard approved14September2022: Purpose describes hunting hare/fox/small ungulates, speed with endurance and scent during search. Behavior/temperament states calm temperament with a well-developed visual reaction, leisurely trot or walk before quarry rises and full gallop in pursuit. Historical overview describes breeding in southern Russia. These are breed-standard descriptions, not individual safety, suitability or performance guarantees. The same standard explicitly says this breed is not recognized by FCI; do not confuse FCI group placement with recognition.
